# Kira Zakirova — Portfolio

## About

Kira Zakirova is a senior frontend engineer with 10+ years of professional experience across 8 companies. She specialises in React, TypeScript, and frontend architecture design systems. Currently studying a Bachelor of Game Design and Development at Torrens University Australia.

- Frontend architecture and design systems
- Redux, React Query, Material UI, Styled Components
- REST APIs, AWS, MongoDB
- AI/LLM integration in products and workflows
- Blender, Maya, Adobe Creative Suite
